blocks.html: The Federal Reserve implemented two additional rate cuts during the fourth quarter, bringing the Fed Funds rate down to 3.75%. After holding rates steady for nine months, the Fed resumed easing as labor market conditions softened in the latter part of the year. blocks.html: Fund Overview | Q4 2025

On March 29, 2024, we held the final close for Blue Owl Real Estate Fund VI (the “Fund” or “Fund VI”) for a total of $5.2 billion in capital commitments, our largest closed-end net lease real estate fund to date. Since holding our first close in December 2022, we have acquired $7.2 billion in gross assets, totaling 26 investments across 521 properties. We have a strong pipeline of attractive potential transactions and remain focused on delivering excellent risk-adjusted returns to our investors.

15.0% increase YoY, while non-GAAP net income attributable to Intel rose 35.0% YoY to $767 million
• The company's Data Center and AI segment was a standout performer, generating $4.7 billion in revenue
during the quarter—a 9.0% increase YoY—underscoring Intel's expanding role in AI-driven infrastructure
• The company further strengthened its balance sheet during the quarter through the completion of a $5.0
billion common stock sale to NVIDIA and continued progress on U.S. government funding, enhancing
financial flexibility as Intel ramps its 18A process technology into high-volume manufacturing
